headline: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is a robot foundation model trained on 100K+ hours of real-world data
summary: This ready-to-use model breaks the data barrier in robotics, combining large-scale embodiment-free pre-training with real-robot data. Its performance scales predictably with more data and model size.
details: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is a new, ready-to-use robot foundation model. It has been trained on over 100,000 hours of real-world manipulation trajectories, aiming to advance robot capabilities significantly.

Robotics has lagged behind language and vision models in scaling due to a scarcity of large-scale, high-quality data. Xiaomi-Robotics-1 addresses this by combining extensive embodiment-free (UMI) pre-training with a modest amount of real-robot post-training data.

For pre-training, the model utilized 100,000 hours of embodiment-free UMI trajectories. This data spans over 1,700 diverse scenarios, including household, commercial, industrial, and outdoor spaces, covering a wide range of tasks.

A scalable auto-labeling pipeline was developed to annotate these trajectories. It divides them into fixed-length segments and describes scene state transitions using language, enabling the model to learn general action generation.

Post-training involved leveraging cross-embodiment datasets, including over 7,200 hours of in-house real-robot data collected in homes for tasks like tidying and sorting. This stage aligns the model with real robot embodiments and instruction-following.

The training follows a two-stage paradigm: pre-training learns general action representations from large-scale UMI data, while post-training aligns the model with specific real robot hardware and natural language instructions.

An encouraging finding is the clean scaling behavior observed during pre-training, where validation action error steadily decreases as data and model size increase. This indicates predictable improvements with more resources.

After post-training, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 can be used out-of-the-box for various mobile manipulation tasks in the real world. Evaluations show that stronger pre-trained models consistently yield better real-robot performance, with scaling gains showing no signs of saturation.

headline: iOS 27 makes your iPhone faster in over 30 ways across core apps
summary: Apple's upcoming iOS 27 update brings significant performance enhancements, speeding up key functionalities like Photos, Safari, and Camera. Users can expect a more responsive experience.
details: Apple's new iOS 27 update is set to deliver over 30 distinct performance improvements across the iPhone operating system. These enhancements aim to make the user experience noticeably faster and more fluid.

Key areas targeted for speed boosts include core applications such as Photos, Safari, and Camera. Users will likely see quicker app launches, smoother navigation, and faster processing within these frequently used apps.
